title: goodyera hachijoensis var. boninensis
intro: Goodyera hachijoensis var. boninensis, commonly known as the Bonin goodyera or Bonin rattlesnake plant, is a species of orchid endemic to the Bonin Islands. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Goodyera hachijoensis var. boninensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which are said to reduce pain and inflammation, lower fever, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
